summary: Iteration 17: Tested Undo Year-End Closing feature. Backend 40/40 tests pass. Frontend all key flows verified with 1 minor UI bug found.

ui_bugs.issue: After undoing the most recent closing (when multiple closings exist), the remaining (previously-locked) closing incorrectly shows 'Undone' green label instead of 'Undo' button. Root cause: `undoDone` state is set after any undo and is never reset when history is filtered — so the new i=0 entry inherits the 'Undone' label. Workaround: close and reopen the modal. Fix: track which specific closing_date was undone, or reset undoDone when remaining history is non-empty.

action_items: FIX (LOW priority): YearEndClosingModal - After undoing the most recent closing, the remaining most-recent closing shows 'Undone' label instead of 'Undo' button. Fix in handleUndo: track which specific closing date was undone (e.g., use `const [undoDoneDate, setUndoDoneDate] = useState(null)` instead of `undoDone`) so the label only appears on the entry that was actually undone.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: YearEndClosingModal `undoDone` state is shared across all rows. After undoing (say) 2025-03-31, the filtered history shows 2024-03-31 as i=0, and since `undoDone.undone_count > 0`, it renders 'Undone' for 2024-03-31 which was NOT undone. Fix: replace `undoDone` with `undoDoneDate` (string) tracking which specific closing_date was undone.
OK: routes/loans.py history endpoint correctly uses gyal_since as a grouping key and sorts descending - works correctly.
OK: undo endpoint properly checks for newer closings before allowing undo (gyal_since $gt closing_date).
OK: undo endpoint deletes gyal_writeoff journal entries by reference_id, entry_type, and illaka_id - good specificity.
OK: YearEndClosingModal sticky header with max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto - modal is scrollable for many closings.

rca_of_issue.bug: Undone label shown on wrong row in YearEndClosingModal
rca_of_issue.reproduction: 1. Open year-end modal for an illaka with 2+ closings (e.g., 2025-03-31 and 2024-03-31). 2. Click Undo on 2025-03-31 (most recent). 3. History updates to show only 2024-03-31. 4. 2024-03-31 now shows 'Undone' green label (incorrect - it was not undone).
rca_of_issue.root_cause: In handleUndo, `setUndoDone(res.data)` stores the undo result but this state is used for ALL rows: `{i === 0 && undoDone && undoDone.undone_count > 0 ? <Undone/> : <UndoBtn/>}`. After the undone entry is filtered out of history, the new i=0 entry inherits the Undone state.
rca_of_issue.fix: In IllakaManagement.jsx, replace `const [undoDone, setUndoDone] = useState(null)` with `const [undoDoneDate, setUndoDoneDate] = useState(null)`. In handleUndo: `setUndoDoneDate(closingDateToUndo)`. In render: `undoDoneDate === h.closing_date ? <Undone/> : <UndoBtn/>`
